name: Whiteboard Marker
tagline: A marker draws each thought as you say it. Red, blue, black on white.

motion.direction: Whiteboard explainer. A marker draws each thought as it is said: short phrases (2–5 words) in the marker hand, `equation`s for cause → effect, `strikeLine` through a myth, `counter`s for numbers, `chips` as labels in marker colours (`ter` red, `gold` blue, `goldd` green on `iv`). Photos are taped sketches (`imageCard`, tilt ±2). At most two things on the board at once; ideas wipe away before the next. Calm camera, no punch-ins except one `zoom` on the key prop. No stamps, no slams, no film strips, no bleed plates.
